PANEL.TITLE: Set up UniverZAP
PANEL.SUBTITLE: {done} of {total} steps complete
PANEL.INTRO: Connect WhatsApp, invite your team and meet Athenas — your AI assistant.
PANEL.ALL_DONE_BODY: UniverZAP is fully configured. Your first conversation will appear in the inbox.

INBOX.TITLE: Connect a WhatsApp channel
INBOX.DESCRIPTION: Hook up your first WhatsApp number so customer messages flow in.

TEAM_MEMBERS.TITLE: Invite your atendentes
TEAM_MEMBERS.DESCRIPTION: Bring your team in — they'll respond to conversations.

TEAM_GROUP.TITLE: Create a team
TEAM_GROUP.DESCRIPTION: Group atendentes by department to route conversations smartly.

ASSISTANT.TITLE: Configure Athenas AI
ASSISTANT.DESCRIPTION: Train your AI assistant to qualify leads and reply 24/7.

FIRST_REPLY.TITLE: Send your first reply
FIRST_REPLY.DESCRIPTION: Reply to your first conversation to mark UniverZAP as live.

KANBAN.TITLE: Build your sales pipeline
KANBAN.DESCRIPTION: Use Kanban to track every lead from first message to closed deal.

CONTACTS.TITLE: Your customer book
CONTACTS.DESCRIPTION: Every contact and conversation lives here — segment, tag and reach them in seconds.

REPORTS.TITLE: Measure what matters
REPORTS.DESCRIPTION: Track response time, SLA, CSAT and pipeline health in real time.

TOUR.WELCOME_BODY: Let's get your workspace ready in under 5 minutes. We'll point you to exactly where you need to click.
TOUR.CLICK_HINT: Click the highlighted area to continue
TOUR.EXIT_CONFIRM_BODY: You can resume from the launcher anytime.
TOUR.FINISH_BODY: UniverZAP is live. Your first conversation will appear in the inbox.

SIDEBAR_CONVERSATIONS.TITLE: Your conversations live here
SIDEBAR_CONVERSATIONS.BODY: Every WhatsApp message lands in this inbox. Filter by agent, team, label or status.

ATHENAS_NAV.TITLE: Meet Athenas AI
ATHENAS_NAV.BODY: Your assistant qualifies, replies and routes conversations to the pipeline while you sleep.

ATHENAS_BILLING.TITLE: Your Athenas balance
ATHENAS_BILLING.BODY: Each AI reply burns a tiny credit. Top up whenever you want — no mandatory monthly subscription.

KANBAN_FUNNEL.TITLE: Pick the funnel you're working
KANBAN_FUNNEL.BODY: Build as many funnels as you need — sales, post-sale, recovery — and switch between them here.

KANBAN_ADD.TITLE: Drop tasks into the funnel
KANBAN_ADD.BODY: Kanban cards are tasks — leads, proposals, recoveries. Drag them across stages as deals move.

ATHENAS_BALANCE.TITLE: Athenas balance, always visible
ATHENAS_BALANCE.BODY: Every AI reply burns from this balance. Click here to top up anytime.

RESOLVE.TITLE: Resolve, snooze or pend
RESOLVE.BODY: When the conversation wraps, mark it resolved. ⌥E clears it from the queue in one shot.

MOVE_KANBAN.TITLE: Move to the funnel
MOVE_KANBAN.BODY: Every chat can become a Kanban task. Follow the lead to the close without leaving the inbox.

AUTOPILOT.TITLE: Turn on autopilot
AUTOPILOT.BODY: Athenas takes the wheel, qualifies the lead and pings you only when it's ripe.

BILLING.TITLE: Your balance + packages
BILLING.BODY: Top up in one click. Bigger packages return bigger bonuses straight to your credit balance.

NEW_ASSISTANT.TITLE: Spin up your first assistant
NEW_ASSISTANT.BODY: No code. In under 5 minutes your Athenas replies in the right tone, with your business knowledge baked in.

NAME.TITLE: Give it an identity
NAME.BODY: Name, role and tone. Customers trust assistants that feel like people, not generic bots.

PROMPT.TITLE: The prompt is the brain
PROMPT.BODY: Here you teach how Athenas should think, talk and what she can never promise. Nail this.

RAG.TITLE: Knowledge base
RAG.BODY: Upload docs, FAQs or product catalogues. Athenas consults them in real time for precise answers.

FUNNEL.TITLE: Switch between funnels
FUNNEL.BODY: Build sales, post-sale and recovery funnels. Each one with its own stages and rules.

ADD.TITLE: Create cards in seconds
ADD.BODY: Add tasks straight to the column. Each card can be tied to a conversation or a contact.
